column1: # The systems Lotus runs on – read by the website and the README. status: supported · beta · development

column4: macOS 11 or newer, zsh (bash 4.4 or newer works too)
column5: Apple silicon and Intel. Homebrew or the install script.

column4: zsh (the installer offers it), curl, a terminal with UTF-8
column5: Tested in containers on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12, Fedora 42 and Arch. zsh or bash as your shell. The install script; no administrator rights.

column4: Windows 11 (or 10), PowerShell 7.2 or newer, Windows Terminal
column5: A native PowerShell module, no WSL, no administrator rights. Tested on every change on GitHub's Windows machines (x64 and Arm64) – not yet by people in a real window. The install script (irm … | iex).
